draft.email_subject: Automating direct shipper quotes for Athena Global Logistics Pvt. Ltd. (skip 18% broker cuts)
draft.email_body:
Hi Team Athena Global Logistics Pvt. Ltd.,

I was checking out commercial freight and transport operators in Mumbai and came across your business.

The #1 bottleneck in freight right now is quote turnaround time: shippers searching for trucks request 3 quotes and book the first one who responds within 15 minutes. We build direct WhatsApp freight rate estimators and automated dispatch bots that capture shippers instantly and help fleet operators bypass 15-25% broker commissions.

Would you be open to a 5-minute screen share this week to see how this works for your lane routes?

Warm regards,
Freight Automation & Tech Team
pain_points: Paying 15-25% broker margins on freight spot loads
Slow quote turnaround: Shippers abandon inquiries if quote takes >15 minutes
Manual phone & WhatsApp driver dispatch causing coordination bottlenecks
Lack of instant mobile freight rate estimator and shipment status bot
draft.business_loss: Losing 15-20% margin to freight brokers and ~8-12 spot loads weekly due to delayed manual quote turnaround
